get.description: The Map Display API Vector service delivers vector tiles which are representations of square sections of map data.

parameters.name: layer
parameters.description: Layer of tile to be rendered.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Zoom level of tile to be rendered.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: x coordinate of a tile on a zoom grid.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: y coordinate of a tile on a zoom grid.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Geopolitical view. Determines the rendering of disputed areas. See the documentation for an explanation of how this works in live services.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
List of additional data types to be included in the tile.
Values must be placed between '[' and ']' and separated by a ','.
Actual supported values:
  - road_restrictions - includes road restriction-related data based on the provided vehicle profile.

parameters.name: vehicleWeight
parameters.description: Weight of the vehicle in kilograms.

parameters.name: vehicleAxleWeight
parameters.description: Weight per axle of the vehicle in kilograms.

parameters.name: numberOfAxles
parameters.description: Number of vehicle axles.

parameters.name: vehicleLength
parameters.description: Length of the vehicle in meters.

parameters.name: vehicleWidth
parameters.description: Width of the vehicle in meters.

parameters.name: vehicleHeight
parameters.description: Height of the vehicle in meters.

parameters.name: generalLoadType
parameters.description:
List of the vehicle general load types.
Values must be placed between `[` and `]` and separated by a `,`.
Actual supported values:
  - General_Hazardous_Materials
  - Explosive_Materials
  - Goods_Harmful_To_Water

parameters.name: dangerousGoodsLoadType
parameters.description:
List of the vehicle dangerous goods load types.
Values must be placed between `[` and `]` and separated by a `,`.
Actual supported values:
  - Explosives
  - Gases
  - Flammable_Liquids
  - Flammable_Solids
  - Oxidizing_And_Organic_Substance
  - Toxic_And_Infectious_Substance
  - Radioactive_Material
  - Corrosives
  - Miscellaneous_Dangerous_Goods

parameters.name: adrCategory
parameters.description: Vehicle ADR category.

parameters.name: commercialVehicle
parameters.description: Indicates a commercial vehicle.

parameters.name: travelMode
parameters.description: Travel mode to be included in restriction data.

parameters.name: emissionClass
parameters.description:
List of the emission classes.
Values must be placed between `[` and `]` and separated by a `,`.
Actual supported values:
  - EmissionClass0
  - EmissionClass1
  - EmissionClass2
  - EmissionClass3
  - EmissionClass4
  - EmissionClass5
  - EmissionClass6
  - EmissionClass7
  - EmissionClass8
  - EmissionClass9
  - EmissionClass10

parameters.name: engineType
parameters.description:
List of the engine types.
Values must be placed between `[` and `]` and separated by a `,`.
Actual supported values:
  - LPG
  - CNG
  - LNG
  - Diesel
  - Petrol
  - Hydrogen
  - Electric
  - Hybrid
  - Plugin_Hybrid

parameters.name: travelModeProfile
parameters.description:
Combination of vehicle-related parameters with travelMode in the short version.
Instead of passing all parameters separately, it can be provided in a single, comma-separated parameter.
<travelMode>,<vehicleWeight>,<vehicleAxleWeight>,<numberOfAxles>,<vehicleLength>,<vehicleWidth>,<vehicleHeight>,<generalLoadType>,<dangerousGoodsLoadType>,<adrCategory>,<commercialVehicle>,<emissionClass>,<engineType>
- <travelMode> - Travel mode to be included in the restriction data. Travel mode Mapping: - 0 - Car - 1 - Truck - 2 - Taxi - 3 - Bus - 4 - Van - 5 - Motorcycle - 6 - Bicycle - 7 - Pedestrian - 8 - Other - <vehicleWeight> - Weight of the vehicle in kilograms. - <vehicleAxleWeight> - Weight per axle of the vehicle in kilograms. - <numberOfAxles> - Number of vehicle axles. - <vehicleLength> - Length of the vehicle in meters. - <vehicleWidth> - Width of the vehicle in meters. - <vehicleHeight> - Height of the vehicle in meters. - <generalLoadType> - List of the vehicle general load types. Values must be placed between `[` and `]` and separated by a `,`. General load type mapping: - 0 - General_Hazardous_Materials - 1 - Explosive_Materials - 2 - Goods_Harmful_To_Water - <dangerousGoodsLoadType> - List of the vehicle dangerous goods load types. Values must be placed between `[` and `]` and separated by a `,`. Vehicle dangerous goods load type mapping: - 0 - Explosives - 1 - Gases - 2 - Flammable_Liquids - 3 - Flammable_Solids - 4 - Oxidizing_And_Organic_Substance - 5 - Toxic_And_Infectious_Substance - 6 - Radioactive_Material - 7 - Corrosives - 8 - Miscellaneous_Dangerous_Goods - <adrCategory> - Vehicle ADR category. Vehicle ADR category possible values: - B - C - D - E - <commercialVehicle> - Indicates a commercial vehicle. Commercial vehicle possible values: - 0 - 1 - <emissionClass> - List of the emission classes. Values must be placed between `[` and `]` and separated by a `,`. Emission class mapping: - 0 - EmissionClass0 - 1 - EmissionClass1 - 2 - EmissionClass2 - 3 - EmissionClass3 - 4 - EmissionClass4 - 5 - EmissionClass5 - 6 - EmissionClass6 - 7 - EmissionClass7 - 8 - EmissionClass8 - 9 - EmissionClass9 - 10 - EmissionClass10 - <engineType> - List of the engine types. Values must be placed between `[` and `]` and separated by a `,`. Engine type mapping: - 0 - LPG - 1 - CNG - 2 - LNG - 3 - Diesel - 4 - Petrol - 5 - Hydrogen - 6 - Electric - 7 - Hybrid - 8 - Plugin_Hybrid
0,1500,,,5.5,,2.2,,,,,, means Car, weight 1500kg, length 5.5m, height 2.2
1,,,3,,3.1,,,,,,, means Truck, 3 axles, width 3.1m

get.description:
The Static Image service renders a rectangular raster image
in the style, size, and zoom level specified. The image can be requested
using either a center point plus width and height or a bounding box.

parameters.name: layer
parameters.description: Layer of the image to be rendered. Hybrid and labels are intended for layering with other data and are only available in png format.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Map style to be returned.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Image format to be returned.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Zoom level of map image to be returned.

parameters.name: center
parameters.description: Coordinates for the center point of the image. Must be used with the width and height parameters; cannot be used with bbox. Uses EPSG:3857 projection (functionally equivalent to EPSG:900910).

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the resulting image in pixels. Width must be a positive integer between 1 and 8192.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the resulting image in pixels. Height must be a positive integer between 1 and 8192.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box for the image, using EPSG:3857 projection (functionally equivalent to EPSG:900910). Values must be in the order of minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat. MaxLat must be greater than minLat. Longitude values can be on both sides of the 180th meridian. Cannot be used with center, width, or height parameters.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Geopolitical view. Determines rendering of disputed areas. See the documentation for an explanation of how this works in live services.

400.description: Bad Request: Received by the interface, but there is an error in the Request, such as: - one or more of the required parameters is missing - unsupported or unrecognized parameter value - two or more mutually exclusive parameters are used in the same query (e.g. mixing center/width/height and bbox.) - minimum latitude is greater than maximum latitude in a bbox call - layer containing alpha channel is requested in format not supporting the alpha channel This code is returned if the required parameters of the Request were malformed. A detailed exception explanation is returned in a Response in form of Service Exception Report.

403.description: Forbidden: - Supplied API key is not valid for the Request. - The requested view is not available in the country where the Request was sent from.

500.description: Internal Server Error: There is a problem with the Static Map Service.
